subject: Post-call exec recap: AuroraMed — leadership summary & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@auroramed.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@auroramed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: AuroraMed — leadership summary & next steps

Hi Elena / Mike — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap for the AuroraMed leadership team and next steps we agreed on. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain / goals
- Current pain: slow turnaround on physician note summarization and high per-call transcription costs across 10k monthly visits.
- Outcome sought: reduce latency for summarization to <2s per note in clinician workflows and lower per-note inference cost by ~40%.
- Risk: PHI surface and SOC 2 compliance requirements; procurement requires security artifacts and legal review prior to any pilot.

Key stakeholders mentioned
- Dr. Elena Cruz (Executive Sponsor — Clinical Ops)
- Mike Turner (Procurement Lead)
- CTO (final technical sign-off; TBD name)

What Redwood shows in a pilot
- Private-deployment on VPC with customer-managed KMS, token-level audit logs, and per-route latency SLOs.
- Baseline perf: expect 1.5-2.0s p90 for 512-token notes using our optimized runtime; projected cost savings with batching / quantization profile.

Decisions / asks from AuroraMed
- Procurement needs: SOC 2 Type II report, data retention policy, and network architecture diagram. (Mike to confirm exact recipients and timing.)
- Executive asks: 8-12 week pilot timeline; success metric = 40% cost reduction or end-user adoption improvement by 20%.

Next steps (mutual action plan)
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 artifacts, security whitepaper, and network diagram by Tue 3/16. (Marissa)
2) AuroraMed to share final list of users for pilot and preferred test dataset scope by 3/19. (Elena)
3) Legal/procurement: AuroraMed to confirm contracting timeline and required redlines; plan for SOW review week of 3/22. (Mike)
4) Tech sync: Redwood infra + AuroraMed infra > 60-min call to review private deployment and KMS flow; target week of 3/22. (Marissa / Aditya)

Attachments: AuroraMed_MA_Overview_v1.pdf (high-level pilot scope)

Thanks — I'll follow up with the artifacts and a calendar invite for the tech sync.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
https://www.redwoodinference.com

--
Note: Attached PDF is a one-page mutual action overview.

Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: AuroraMed — leadership summary & next steps

Marissa — great recap. A couple quick internal notes for prioritization and escalation:
- This looks like a high-fit pilot: strong exec sponsor + clear cost-out outcome. Please flag any data isolation asks that require Dedicated vs Private — we should avoid surprises in pricing.
- If procurement requests contract language around indemnity/data residency, route to legal and loop in me if timelines slip past 3/26.
- Aditya: please prepare a 30-min tech deep dive deck that includes our expected latency numbers on AuroraMed-like workloads and fallback policies if we need to degrade to a cheaper model.

Cc'ing Elena & Mike so they see our internal action items. Marissa — happy for you to send the SOC 2 and network diagram as planned.

Laura Bennett
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
